round_assessment.reason: The fixed-offset sixth-chain average loses endpoint phases and its complete certificate has a T^(10beta) floor on actual masked magnitudes, certified by a different real rephasing. Exact pair-divisor completion has a small zero mode but its entire nonzero-mode package retains the full correlation capacity; the phase-erased actual Fejer certificate costs T^3 globally. Both attacks restore every block, level and tail and leave the accepted complete10beta bound unchanged. Finite identities and scoped certificate bounds are reviewed evidence, not a new complete estimate or an actual signed lower bound.

reversibility.rule: Identity in-memory application, inverse and replay; graph and proof-draft bytes never rewritten.
